character: white farm duck, angry payer at the lens; fills two thirds of frame height in every window
cast: fat gander manager in a tight waistcoat, owns the terminal, feeds off the tape, never speaks; in frame from 2.1
motion_rule: no window ends in a pose, its last frame is the first of the next move; long windows carry two moves in opposite directions; one take, the camera moves in every window, never still, never the same shot size twice
props: post terminal on the bank, beeps and prints tape by itself, the tape crawls out nonstop and loops on the ground; card-chip cords on her legs, one at 0.0, three by 3.2, six by 6.7, a bitten one regrows; her egg bank drops a coin per beep
environment: village pond at noon, direct sun, hard shadows; background never still, under a third of frame

audio.delivery: female duck voice, native Russian stress
audio.pronunciation: плачу at 1.4 is pla-CHU, paying money; плачу at 3.9 is PLA-chu, weeping, never pla-CHU
audio.pacing: one phrase 0.5 to 6.7, no breath at any join

timeline.a: the leg cord snaps taut and hauls her half a body back, wings up
0.5-0.9 she leans her whole body at the lens; 0.9-1.4 the cord throws her back to the post
timeline.c: waist, arcs right round the post

timeline.a: she bites a cord off, it snaps back regrown before it lands, a coin rolling off
timeline.c: close on the cord, pushes to the coin

timeline.a: 2.1-2.6 the gander drops a second cord on her leg, she squats under it; 2.6-3.2 she wheels left round the post and tangles, three cords
timeline.c: full height, walks left round the post

timeline.a: she slams a wing on the terminal, it beeps and shoots tape that whips across her chest
timeline.c: low mid, rises up the post

timeline.a: a fat tear swells and drops off her beak onto the tape, her head dropping after it
timeline.c: macro on the beak, eases to the tear

timeline.a: her head snaps round to the gander, a wing thrown out at him across the frame
timeline.c: mid, hard pan to the gander

timeline.a: he catches a coin from her egg bank in his beak and swallows, the bank tipping over
timeline.c: waist on him, drops after the bank

timeline.a: 5.8-6.2 he treads the terminal button, the tape bursts out and knocks her off her feet; 6.2-6.7 she falls, loops winding on her, cords doubling to six
she hooks the tape with a foot and yanks it round the gander's legs
timeline.c: low on the legs, slides sideways

timeline.a: 7.3-7.6 she rolls over her back, winding him into the tape; 7.6-8.0 she stands and hauls it in, he topples forward
8.0-8.4 she rips the chip off her own leg; 8.4-8.8 she slaps it onto his leg, it sticks and the cords slide off her onto him
timeline.c: close on the chip, pushes onto it

timeline.a: the terminal beeps, coins burst out of him and shower the frame, each beep jolting him
timeline.c: wide, lifts hard over the coins

timeline.a: she sweeps the coins into her egg bank with both wings and heaves it to the lens, the last cord snapping off her
timeline.c: mid front, rises with the bank

must_appear: the tear on her beak at 3.9; a cord on her leg in every window to 8.4
negative_prompt: cyrillic, subtitles, dark scene, slow motion, any Russian word outside the lines, speech after 6.7, the gander speaking, male voice, extra legs, extra wings, a second white duck, a pose held to the end of a window, a move played out early, both плачу said with the same stress, cords on her legs after 8.4
